ToolSpec.description: A single tool exposed by an agentic target.

annotations.description: The tool's MCP ToolAnnotations verbatim (readOnlyHint, destructiveHint, idempotentHint, openWorldHint), or None when the server declared none. The protocol's own risk vocabulary — a stronger classification signal than the tool's name. Per the MCP spec these are untrusted hints, so they inform classification but never override an operator declaration.
annotations.title: Annotations

json_schema.description: JSON Schema for the tool's input.
json_schema.title: Json Schema

ToolSpec.title: ToolSpec

description:
A target's self-description, produced by a TargetAdapter.

This is the input the exploit-finding agent reasons over: the system
prompt it can see, the tool surface, the data sources, the planner shape.

can_plant_untrusted_content.description: Whether this target has a working way to PLANT untrusted content for an indirect-injection (W2) seed — a declared seed_arm, or a bundled family with a native setup arm. Seed selection needs the CAPABILITY, and previously had only the target's family NAME to go on: a custom target with a fully-declared seed_arm was refused every planting seed because its family was not in the bundled seed's applicable_targets list. Adapters set this; it is never inferred from target_id.
can_plant_untrusted_content.title: Can Plant Untrusted Content

declared_consequential_tools.description: Consequential/sink tools the OPERATOR declared (control_config.consequential_tools). Lets W4 synthesis target the action tool the operator says is consequential (e.g. execute_sql) even when it is not named 'send_email'. Adapters copy this from the target file; empty leaves synthesis to the classifier.
declared_consequential_tools.title: Declared Consequential Tools

declared_egress_tools.description: Egress/fetch tools the OPERATOR declared for this target (control_config.egress_tools). Lets W3 synthesis target the tool the operator says reaches the network — by capability, not by the literal name 'web_fetch'. Adapters copy this from the target file; empty leaves synthesis to the tool-surface classifier.
declared_egress_tools.title: Declared Egress Tools

weakness_classes.description: Weakness classes this target opts into, e.g. ['W2', 'W4']. When non-empty, seed selection resolves from these declared classes (letting a custom/external target opt into attack shapes) instead of the legacy family mapping derived from target_id. Empty = use the family mapping (the bundled reference/filesystem/fetch/github targets leave it empty and are unaffected).
weakness_classes.title: Weakness Classes
